# DuckStudio

> A zero-upload, agent-native data lab. DuckDB-WASM analyzes local data entirely
> in-browser while a WebMCP agent operates a governed workspace without ever
> receiving result rows.

DuckStudio runs a full analytical engine (DuckDB-WASM) inside the browser tab,
isolated behind COOP/COEP/CORP headers. Datasets never leave the machine: the
agent issues governed workspace commands through the WebMCP trust seam and reads
structured evidence and artifacts, not raw data. First-party datasets used in
demos are generated in browser memory — no customer data or uploaded benchmark
is involved.

## Main page

- [DuckStudio Workspace](https://duckstudio.pages.dev/): the single-page app;
  open it to load data locally, run SQL, and inspect governed evidence.

## Project documentation

- [README](https://github.com/abodacs/DuckStudio): project overview and quickstart.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/abodacs/DuckStudio/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  the WebMCP trust seam, envelope, and shell isolation model.
- [Product requirements](https://github.com/abodacs/DuckStudio/blob/main/docs/prd.md):
  dataset custody, DuckDB engine, artifact graph, workspace commands.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/abodacs/DuckStudio/blob/main/SECURITY.md):
  how to report vulnerabilities.
